# Subtests

ROAR-Phoneme has three subtests: matching the first sound of words,
matching the last sound, and deleting a sound. It is calibrated separately
for each language, and there is no German version.

```{r pa-items}
pa_items <- items |>
  mutate(subtest = coalesce(na_if(item_group_label, ""), item_group), language = lang_names[lang])
pa_subtests <- pa_items |>
  group_by(language, subtest) |>
  summarise(n_items = n(), difficulty = mean(difficulty), .groups = "drop")
pa_acc <- trials |>
  filter(!is.na(correct)) |>
  mutate(subtest = c(fsm = "first-sound matching", lsm = "last-sound matching",
                     del = "deletion")[item_group],
         age = floor(age_at_run(run_id)), language = lang_names[lang]) |>
  filter(!is.na(subtest), !is.na(age), between(age, 4, 13)) |>
  group_by(language, subtest, age) |>
  summarise(accuracy = mean(correct), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 50)
```

```{r pa-subtest-plot, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-pa-subtests
#| fig-cap: "Calibrated item difficulty by subtest and language: each item (points) and the subtest mean (bar)."
pa_items |>
  ggplot(aes(x = subtest, y = difficulty, colour = language)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.6), alpha = 0.6) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(English = "#4477AA", Spanish = "#CC6677"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Item difficulty") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r pa-acc-plot, fig.height=4}
#| label: fig-pa-acc
#| fig-cap: "Accuracy by subtest and age, by language (cells with 50 or more responses). The dotted line is chance."
pa_acc |>
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = accuracy, colour = subtest)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1 / 3, lty = 3, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(vars(language)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`first-sound matching` = "#4477AA", `last-sound matching` = "#CC6677",
                                 deletion = "#228833"), name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Age (years)", y = "Accuracy") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

Mean item difficulty by subtest:
`r with(pa_subtests, paste0(language, " ", subtest, " ", f2(difficulty), " (", n_items, " items)", collapse = "; "))`.

# Open issues

`r below_chance_issue()`
- The deletion subtest is in the English bank only.
- With separate calibrations, scores can't be compared across languages.
